AgentEvent.description: One Server-Sent Event `data:` payload from /agents/generate or /agents/chat.
AgentEvent.title: AgentEvent

Atom.description:
`course`: met by a course completed, credited or planned in a strictly earlier term.
`concurrent`: same or earlier term. `placement`/`standing`: plan facts.
`program`: enrolment restriction (glob on program ids, e.g. `cmsc-*`).
`consent`: never blocks; always produces a warning.
Atom.title: Atom

BoundedPartsNode.description: Parts with [min, max] counts that sum to a total.
BoundedPartsNode.title: BoundedPartsNode

ChangeSetApply.description:
Apply only if the plan still hashes to `base_plan_hash`. `confirmation_text` is the
student's typed confirmation, parsed deterministically and matched against the ops.
ChangeSetApply.title: ChangeSetApply

Conflict.description: One goal or limit in the smallest set that makes a request impossible.
Conflict.title: Conflict

CourseForumOut.description:
Course-level view: every instructor's page of one course, pooled (SPEC "Course-level
view: the course page aggregates all its instructors").
CourseForumOut.title: CourseForumOut

CourseList.description:
A named list per catalog year. Members = `courses` plus every course of `sublists`.
A list of sequences (e.g. `core-huma-sequences`) has one sublist per sequence.
CourseList.title: CourseList

Expr.description:
Canonical form: `{op, n, children, atom}`. Shorthand accepted on input:
`"CMSC 14100"`, `{course: X, min_grade: G}`, `{concurrent: X}`, `{placement: X}`,
`{standing: X}`, `{program: X}`, `{consent: X}`, `{all: [...]}`, `{any: [...]}`,
`{n_of: k, of: [...]}`.
Expr.title: Expr

GenerateLocal.description: Generate for a plan that lives only in the browser (logged out, or not saved yet).
GenerateLocal.title: GenerateLocal

GenerateOptions.description:
The Generate-plan form as the deterministic generator reads it (SPEC "Generate-plan
popup"). Locked and completed courses are always kept.
GenerateOptions.title: GenerateOptions

GenerateRequest.description: The Generate-plan popup: a form, never free text (SPEC "Generate-plan popup").
GenerateRequest.title: GenerateRequest

GeneratedVariant.description: One generated plan: a proposed change set plus the verified plan it leads to.
GeneratedVariant.title: GeneratedVariant

GroupNode.description: Children combined: all of them (`all: true`) or at least `n_of`.
GroupNode.title: GroupNode

MaxFrom.description:
At most `n` of the node's courses may match `selector` ("at most 2 from outside CMSC").

With `as_enrolled`, a course counts only when the code the student enrolled under matches
the selector's subject, number range and tags: a course cross-listed as CMSC 23500 /
CMSC 33550 and taken as CMSC 33550 is not "from the 20000 level".
MaxFrom.title: MaxFrom

NodeProgress.description: Per-node progress for the planner's requirement rail.
NodeProgress.title: NodeProgress

Part.description: One part of a bounded_parts node, e.g. `{id: huma, from: {list: ...}, count: [2, 3]}`.
Part.title: Part

PlanImport.description: Logged-out plans from localStorage, imported at login.
PlanImport.title: PlanImport

PlanItem.description: A course (or an unfilled requirement slot, `slot_ref` = node path) in a term.
PlanItem.title: PlanItem

PostCreate.description: A review requires structured ratings and the term taken; a discussion post has neither.
PostCreate.title: PostCreate

RatingSummary.description:
Averages over the visible reviews of a forum page (or of every page of a course).
Shown to logged-in readers only.
RatingSummary.title: RatingSummary

SelectNode.description: Choose `count` courses (or `units` units) from a selector.
SelectNode.title: SelectNode

Selector.description:
Which catalog courses a node may draw from.

A course matches when it is not in `exclude` (by cross-list group) and every criterion that
is set holds: `codes` (any listed code, by cross-list group), `subject`, `number_range`
(inclusive, on the 5-digit number), `tags` (has any), `list` (member of the named
`course_list`, sublists included), `union` (matches at least one sub-selector).

A course's tag set is `tags` plus `"core:" + t` for each of its `core_tags`, so
`tags: ["core:arts"]` matches a course whose `core_tags` contains `arts`.
Selector.title: Selector

ShareLimit.description:
At most `max` courses shared with programs matching `with` (`type:minor`, `core`,
`program:<id>`), not counting nodes/parts named in `except` (e.g. `language`).
ShareLimit.title: ShareLimit

Source.description: Where a rule came from. `quote` is copied verbatim from the page.
Source.title: Source

Verify a plan against the rules of its catalog year. The report is "valid" only if
the independent checker accepted the solver's certificate. A program the catalog year
